items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: After a few weeks at this camp, one of the best straight men in show business joined our group... Johnny Vigel was this fellow's name

ctx.x:
I've seen Thad quite a few times since those days and he always mentions to someone around whenever we meet that our first meeting was in the Philippines.
I will never forget that day when he and Stanley Facey came to our camp and blew everybody out.

After a few weeks at this camp, one of the best straight men in show business joined our group. For the sake of those that don't know about show business, or never saw vaudeville, a straight man was one that assisted the comedian by asking him a straight question and getting a comical or double meaning answer to make the audiance laugh. Johnny Vigel was this fellow's name, and he was well known in Negro Theatres from coast to coast. Alfred "Slick" Chester was another well known straight man who had been engaged…
One army camp that we played, not far from our camp, was where the Japanese general Yamashita, who had lead the invasion of the Philippines was hanged.
